META_DESCRIPTION: Build savings that stick: named goals, target dates, and sinking funds that turn ‘save more’ into a clear monthly plan. Free to start, private, offline.
OG_DESCRIPTION: Building savings? FincWin gives every goal a target, a date and a progress bar — plus sinking funds for irregular costs.
PERSONA_SUBHEAD: Name your goals, set targets and dates, and let FincWin show you the monthly amount that gets you there.
SITUATION_HEADLINE: You want to save, but it never quite happens
SITUATION_BODY:
There's always something — a bill, a treat, a gap — and the money you meant to save quietly disappears back into spending.

FincWin makes saving deliberate: each goal gets its own envelope, target and timeline, so the money is set aside before it can drift.
HOW_IT_HELPS:
• →Named goals: emergency fund, deposit, holiday — each tracked separately.
  • →Auto-calculated contributions: set a target and date, FincWin works out the monthly amount.
  • →Sinking funds: smooth out irregular costs so they never derail you.
  • →Visible progress: a progress bar per goal keeps momentum up.
